observation: WebContents::OnDidAddMessageToConsole sets the event frame getter from source_frame, the RFH that emitted the message.
WebContents::RenderFrameHostChanged looks up the existing WebFrameMain by the new host's FrameTreeNodeId and updates its RenderFrameHost.
WebFrameMain::From treats kRunningUnloadHandlers separately and resolves the exact old RFH so its security origin remains accurate; when absent it constructs a separate WebFrameMain wrapper.
IsDetachedFrameHost checks running-unload state or RFH inequality with frame_tree_node()->current_frame_host(); its predicate has no same-origin exception.

WebFrameMain caches frame_tree_node_id_ at construction. FrameTreeNodeID() returns this cached field without CheckRenderFrame(), while the RenderFrameHost token changes during UpdateRenderFrameHost().
conclusion: Object identity against contents.mainFrame is not a sufficient persistent identity for a console dump emitted by a retiring top-level document during an RFH swap. Current collector safely reports the rejected dump as invalid/incomplete, but can lose the prior document needed for diagnosis. This source proves the possibility during a swap; it does not assert that every same-origin navigation swaps or that H already lost a dump.
minimalChange: Inside the existing contents console-message callback, synchronously obtain details.frame and the current mainFrame FrameTreeNodeId.
Require both frameTreeNodeId values to be safe nonnegative integers and equal; otherwise increment invalidDumps and return.
Catch getter/lifecycle failure as invalid instead of throwing into business navigation.
Keep checks local to the already bound WebContents; do not export frame IDs, read URLs, add IPC, accept child FrameTreeNodes, wait on navigation, or modify any diagnostic source/budget window.
testsNeeded: Different old/new WebFrameMain objects with the same FrameTreeNodeId accept a valid retiring top-frame pagehide dump.
A different iframe FrameTreeNodeId remains rejected.
Missing/invalid IDs and a throwing getter remain invalid, with no retained untrusted message.
Existing numeric protocol/continuity/capture-loss tests still pass on actual Node.
scope: Read-only pinned upstream source inspection plus immutable evidence. No Electron runtime experiment or native job was started. All other final overlay/source/fixture bindings remain reviewed; final publication recommendation awaits this one collector correction and exact new hash/test result.
